source_differences: Station elevations differ: lift-world 595 m / 1480 m vs 2006 official cableway list (Uradni list RS 103/2006 annex) 602 m / 1487 m. Length (2356 m) and rise (885 m) agree.
Manufacturer: lift-world 'Girak-Garaventa', Wikipedia 'Garaventa' (same lineage, naming only).

An earlier note on this record says the old point (46.28495, 14.49594) is ~150 m west and 'likely the parking'. The operator's own map pin on rtc-krvavec.si/where-are-we is 46.2849476, 14.4959366, i.e. the OLD point to within ~2 m, the operator says parking is directly at the lower station. The Trailforks point 46.284790, 14.497920 used in the correction could not be opened/verified in this check.
An earlier note on this record says top station not found, hiking-trail.net gives a Dom na Gospincu trailhead next to the upper station (see anchors).
Drive power 980 kW (lift-world) vs 986 kW (Uradni list 2006).
valley station elevation: 521 m (skiresort.com: 'gondola valley station (521 m)') (skiresort.com) against 595 m (lift-world), 602 m (hike.uno) (lift-world.info)
